The '''Jedi Enclave holding facilities''' were a group of holding cells owned by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and located near the [[Jedi Enclave]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Following an investigation by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bolook]], [[Handon Guld]] and [[Rickard Lusoff]] were formally charged for the murder of [[Calder Nettic]], and were subsequently escorted to the facility to await trial. The facilities were not located inside the Enclave itself, but were still considered a part of the Enclave. The Enclave was [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|destroyed]] in [[3956 BBY]] at the hands of [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
